about: Target x role delivery cells (KPI K6). Levels are the gate levels in docs/ROADMAP.md. Raise a cell only with gate evidence as defined in docs/CHARTER.md; x86 evidence never raises a native cell.

targets.note: Baseline. Keeps building; not a release target.
